record.context_brief: Global stability for the a/x_n^2+1/x_{n-1} recurrence
record.original_question: Let a>0 and consider the positive solutions of the delay difference equation x_{n+1}=a/x_n^2+1/x_{n-1} for n=0,1,..., with arbitrary positive initial values x_{-1} and x_0. Let x_bar be the unique positive equilibrium of this recurrence. For exactly which values of a is x_bar globally asymptotically stable for all positive initial data?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix a real parameter $a > 0$ and consider the delay difference equation
$$x_{n+1} = \frac{a}{x_n^2} + \frac{1}{x_{n-1}}, \qquad n = 0, 1, 2, \ldots,$$
with arbitrary positive initial values $x_{-1}, x_0 \in (0, \infty)$. The recurrence admits a unique positive equilibrium $\bar{x}$, characterized as the unique positive solution of $\bar{x} = a/\bar{x}^2 + 1/\bar{x}$ (equivalently $\bar{x}^3 - \bar{x} - a = 0$, where the function $t \mapsto t^3 - t$ for $t > 0$ ensures uniqueness in the relevant range and one checks directly that a unique positive fixed point exists for every $a > 0$).

The equilibrium $\bar{x}$ is said to be globally asymptotically stable if it is locally stable (small perturbations of initial data lead to solutions remaining close to $\bar{x}$) and for every choice of positive initial values $x_{-1}, x_0$ the resulting solution satisfies $\lim_{n \to \infty} x_n = \bar{x}$.

Determine the exact set of values $a \in (0, \infty)$ for which the positive equilibrium $\bar{x}$ of this recurrence is globally asymptotically stable for all positive initial data.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not locate a published result that completely characterizes the set of parameters $a > 0$ for which the positive equilibrium of $x_{n+1} = a/x_n^2 + 1/x_{n-1}$ is globally asymptotically stable. Related rational/quadratic difference equations have been studied, but no explicit resolution of this specific global stability question was found.

status_evidence.title: Global Asymptotic Stability in a Class of Difference Equations
status_evidence.snippet: General results on global asymptotic stability of nonnegative equilibria for nonlinear difference equations, but not addressing the specific equation x_{n+1}=a/x_n^2+1/x_{n-1}.
status_evidence.claim: Related framework exists but does not resolve the specific problem.

status_evidence.snippet: Studies quadratic fractional difference equations of similar form, without solving the stated open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Specific characterization of a for global asymptotic stability of x_{n+1}=a/x_n^2+1/x_{n-1} not located.
